ti += 1) {469        t: *kayan_table = vec<kayan_table>at(w*.tables, ti);470        ids: []const kayan_entity = kayan_table_entities(t);471        for (row: u64 = 0; row < ids.length; row += 1) {472            e: kayan_entity = ids[row];473            if (!kayan_alive(w, e)) {474                printfmt("kayan_verify: table {} row {} holds dead entity {}:{}\n",475                    ti, row, e.index, e.generation);476                problems += 1;477                continue;478            }479            slot: *kayan_slot = vec<kayan_slot>at(w*.slots, cast(e.index, u64));480            if (cast(slot*.table, u64) != ti || cast(slot*.row, u64) != row) {481                printfmt("kayan_verify: {}:{} is in table {} row {}, its slot says table {} row {}\n",482                    e.index, e.generation, ti, row, slot*.table, slot*.row);483                problems += 1;484            }485        }486        rows += t*.count;487    }488    if (rows != w*.live) {489        printfmt("kayan_verify: {} rows in tables, {} entities alive\n", rows, w*.live);490        problems += 1;491    }492    return problems;493}494 495// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------496// Printing497// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------498 499// It takes `*const` because it only prints, so a caller walking the tables keeps500// its pointers.501kayan_print_signature: proc(w: *const kayan_world, signature: u64) -> void = {502    printfmt("{");503    first: b32 = 1;504    for (id: u32 = 0; id < w*.component_count; id += 1) {505        if ((signature & kayan_bit(id)) != 0) {506            if (!first) {507                printfmt(" ");508            }509            printfmt("{}", kayan_component_name(w, id));510            first = 0;511        }512    }513    printfmt("}");514}515 516kayan_print_tables: proc(w: *const kayan_world) -> void = {517    for (ti: u64 = 0; ti < w*.tables*.length; ti += 1) {518        t: *kayan_table = vec<kayan_table>at(w*.tables, ti);519        printfmt("    table {} ", cast(ti, i32));520        kayan_print_signature(w, t*.signature);521        printfmt(":");522        ids: []const kayan_entity = kayan_table_entities(t);523        for (row: u64 = 0; row < ids.length; row += 1) {524            e: kayan_entity = ids[row];525            printfmt(" {}:{}", e.index, e.generation);526        }527        printfmt("\n");528    }529}

Tooling

Build and check

tools/check.py runs every program and diffs its output

tools/check.py

1"""Build every lesson, run it, and compare what it prints with its .expected file.2 3    python tools/check.py               every lesson4    python tools/check.py archetype     only lessons whose path contains "archetype"5    python tools/check.py --bless       rewrite the .expected files from this run6    python tools/check.py --sanitize    also build with AddressSanitizer and UBSan7 8A lesson passes only if all four steps are clean:9 10  1. `rin compile` prints nothing but its "generated" line,11  2. the C compiler reports no warnings (-Wall -Wextra -Werror),12  3. the program exits with 0,13  4. its output matches the .expected file beside it, byte for byte.14 15The lessons are the list in build.rin, so there is one list to keep. The16dojo's playgrounds are in it too. Each dojo block is also checked on its own17(`python tools/check.py dojo` for only them): its solution.rin, a whole program18that imports the harness, must build and print its harness.expected;19level1.rin must build and fail, since it has a gap; level2.rin must build.20 21rin is found through RIN, then RIN_HOME, then PATH; its std is the folder beside22it, as `rin build` assumes. The C compiler is CC, or clang.23"""24 25from __future__ import annotations26 27import os28import re29import shutil30import subprocess31import sys32from pathlib import Path33 34ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent35OUT = ROOT / "build" / "check"36 37 38def find_rin() -> Path:39    names = ["rin.exe", "rin"] if os.name == "nt" else ["rin", "rin.exe"]40    if os.environ.get("RIN"):41        return Path(os.environ["RIN"])42    if os.environ.get("RIN_HOME"):43        for name in names:44            candidate = Path(os.environ["RIN_HOME"]) / name45            if candidate.exists():46                return candidate47    for name in names:48        found = shutil.which(name)49        if found:50            return Path(found)51    sys.exit("check: rin not found; set RIN or RIN_HOME, or put rin on PATH")52 53 54def list_from_build_rin(name: str) -> list[str] | None:55    text = (ROOT / "build.rin").read_text(encoding="utf-8")56    block = re.search(rf"^{name}:[^{{]*\{{(.*?)\}}", text, re.S | re.M)57    if not block:58        return None59    return re.findall(r'"([^"]+)"', block.group(1))60 61 62def lessons_from_build_rin() -> list[Path]:63    entries = list_from_build_rin("build_entries")64    if entries is None:65        sys.exit("check: no build_entries in build.rin")66    return [ROOT / entry for entry in entries]67 68 69def run(cmd: list[str], cwd: Path = ROOT,70        env: dict[str, str] | None = None) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess[str]:71    return subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=cwd, env=env, text=True, stdout=subprocess.PIPE,72                          stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, timeout=300)73 74 75# On Windows a sanitized program loads clang_rt.asan_dynamic-x86_64.dll when it76# starts, and exits with 0xC0000135 before main if the DLL is not on PATH. It77# lives in the C compiler's own resource directory, so ask the compiler.78def sanitizer_env(cc: str) -> dict[str, str] | None:79    if os.name != "nt":80        return None81    resource = run([cc, "-print-resource-dir"]).stdout.strip()82    runtime = Path(resource) / "lib" / "windows"83    if not runtime.is_dir():84        return None85    env = dict(os.environ)86    env["PATH"] = str(runtime) + os.pathsep + env.get("PATH", "")87    return env88 89 90def check(rin: Path, cc: str, lesson: Path, bless: bool, sanitize: bool,91          env: dict[str, str] | None) -> tuple[bool, str]:92    stem = lesson.stem93    work = OUT / stem94    work.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)95    c_path = work / f"{stem}.c"96    exe = work / (f"{stem}.exe" if os.name == "nt" else stem)97 98    translate = run([str(rin), "compile", str(lesson), "-o", str(c_path),99                     "--header", str(work / f"{stem}.h")])100    noise = [line for line in translate.stdout.splitlines()101             if line.strip() and not line.startswith("rin: generated")]102    if translate.returncode != 0 or noise:103        return False, "rin compile:\n" + translate.stdout104 105    flags = ["-std=c11", "-g", "-Wall", "-Wextra", "-Werror"]106    flags += [f"-D{define}" for define in list_from_build_rin("build_defines") or []]107    if sanitize:108        flags += ["-fsanitize=address,undefined", "-fno-sanitize-recover=all"]109    includes = ["-I", str(rin.parent), "-I", str(rin.parent / "std")]110    libs = [] if os.name == "nt" else ["-lm"]111    build = run([cc, *flags, *includes, str(c_path), "-o", str(exe), *libs])112    if build.returncode != 0 or build.stdout.strip():113        return False, f"{cc}:\n" + build.stdout114 115    ran = run([str(exe)], env=env)116    if ran.returncode != 0:117        return False, f"exit {ran.returncode}:\n{ran.stdout}"118 119    actual = ran.stdout.replace("\r\n", "\n")120    expected_path = lesson.with_suffix(".expected")121    if bless:122        expected_path.write_text(actual, encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")123        return True, "blessed"124    if not expected_path.exists():125        return False, f"no {expected_path.name}; run with --bless after reading the output:\n{actual}"126    expected = expected_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").replace("\r\n", "\n")127    if actual != expected:128        got, want = actual.splitlines(), expected.splitlines()129        for i in range(max(len(got), len(want))):130            g = got[i] if i < len(got) else "<missing>"131            w = want[i] if i < len(want) else "<missing>"132            if g != w:133                return False, f"line {i + 1}\n  got:  {g}\n  want: {w}"134    return True, ""135 136 137# ---------------------------------------------------------------- the dojo138 139DOJO = ROOT / "dojo"140# A kata in progress is full of unused parameters and locals.141KATA_QUIET = ["-Wno-unused-parameter", "-Wno-unused-variable", "-Wno-unused-but-set-variable",142              "-Wno-unused-function"]143 144 145def dojo_blocks() -> list[Path]:146    roots = [DOJO]147    blocks: list[Path] = []148    for root in roots:149        blocks += sorted((p for p in root.iterdir() if p.is_dir() and re.match(r"\d+\.", p.name)),150                         key=lambda p: int(p.name.split(".")[0]))151    return blocks152 153 154# A kata file is a whole program: it imports what it uses and the harness,155# which has main, so each of the solution and the levels builds where it is.156def dojo_build(rin: Path, cc: str, block: Path, kata: Path, where: str, sanitize: bool,157               quiet: bool) -> tuple[Path | None, str]:158    folder = OUT / "dojo" / block.name159    folder.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)160    c_path = folder / f"{where}.c"161    exe = folder / (f"{where}.exe" if os.name == "nt" else where)162    translate = run([str(rin), "compile", str(kata), "-o", str(c_path),163                     "--header", str(folder / f"{where}.h")])164    noise = [line for line in translate.stdout.splitlines()165             if line.strip() and not line.startswith("rin: generated")]166    if translate.returncode != 0 or noise:167        return None, "rin compile:\n" + translate.stdout168    flags = ["-std=c11", "-g", "-Wall", "-Wextra", "-Werror", *(KATA_QUIET if quiet else [])]169    flags += [f"-D{define}" for define in list_from_build_rin("build_defines") or []]170    if sanitize:171        flags += ["-fsanitize=address,undefined", "-fno-sanitize-recover=all"]172    includes = ["-I", str(rin.parent), "-I", str(rin.parent / "std")]173    libs = [] if os.name == "nt" else ["-lm"]174    build = run([cc, *flags, *includes, str(c_path), "-o", str(exe), *libs])175    if build.returncode != 0 or build.stdout.strip():176        return None, f"{cc}:\n" + build.stdout177    return exe, ""178 179 180def check_dojo(rin: Path, cc: str, block: Path, bless: bool, sanitize: bool,181               env: dict[str, str] | None) -> tuple[bool, str]:182    exe, err = dojo_build(rin, cc, block, block / "solution.rin", "solution", sanitize, False)183    if not exe:184        return False, "solution.rin, " + err185    ran = run([str(exe)], env=env)186    if ran.returncode != 0:187        return False, f"the solution fails its harness, exit {ran.returncode}:\n{ran.stdout}"188    actual = ran.stdout.replace("\r\n", "\n")189    expected_path = block / "harness.expected"190    detail = ""191    if bless:192        expected_path.write_text(actual, encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")193        detail = "blessed"194    elif not expected_path.exists():195        return False, f"no harness.expected; run with --bless after reading the output:\n{actual}"196    elif actual != expected_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").replace("\r\n", "\n"):197        return False, "the harness's output with the solution is not harness.expected"198    for level in (1, 2):199        exe, err = dojo_build(rin, cc, block, block / f"level{level}.rin", f"level{level}", sanitize, True)200        if not exe:201            return False, f"level{level}.rin, " + err202        if level == 1 and run([str(exe)], env=env).returncode == 0:203            return False, "level 1 passes the harness as given; its gap is not a gap"204    return True, detail205 206 207def main() -> int:208    args = sys.argv[1:]209    bless = "--bless" in args210    sanitize = "--sanitize" in args211    filters = [a for a in args if not a.startswith("--")]212 213    rin = find_rin()214    cc = os.environ.get("CC", "clang")215    lessons = [l for l in lessons_from_build_rin()216               if not filters or any(f in str(l) for f in filters)]217 218    env = sanitizer_env(cc) if sanitize else None219 220    failed = 0221    for lesson in lessons:222        ok, detail = check(rin, cc, lesson, bless, sanitize, env)223        name = lesson.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()224        print(f"{'ok  ' if ok else 'FAIL'} {name}" + (f"  ({detail})" if ok and detail else ""))225        if not ok:226            failed += 1227            print("     " + detail.replace("\n", "\n     "))228    print(f"{len(lessons) - failed} of {len(lessons)} passed")229 230    blocks = [b for b in dojo_blocks()231              if not filters or any(f in b.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix() for f in filters)]232    dojo_failed = 0233    for block in blocks:234        ok, detail = check_dojo(rin, cc, block, bless, sanitize, env)235        print(f"{'ok  ' if ok else 'FAIL'} {block.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()}, the solution and the levels"236              + (f"  ({detail})" if ok and detail else ""))237        if not ok:238            dojo_failed += 1239            print("     " + detail.replace("\n", "\n     "))240    if blocks:241        print(f"{len(blocks) - dojo_failed} of {len(blocks)} dojo blocks passed")242    return 1 if failed or dojo_failed else 0243 244 245if __name__ == "__main__":246    sys.exit(main())

1"""The dojo's runner: start a kata, run it against its harness, keep your times.2 3    python tools/dojo.py                         the blocks, your reps, and what is due4    python tools/dojo.py start slot_map 2        a fresh kata.rin from level 2; the clock starts5    python tools/dojo.py slot_map                build the harness with your kata.rin and run it6    python tools/dojo.py slot_map --seed 42 --stop 13377                                                 the same fuzz run, stopping before operation 13378    python tools/dojo.py slot_map --sanitize     with AddressSanitizer and UBSan9    python tools/dojo.py play slot_map           the block's playground10 11A block can be named by its number, its name, or the start of its name:12`3`, `slot_map` and `slot` are the same block.13 14When a started kata passes, the time since `start` is added to dojo/log.md,15and the block is due again after 1, 3, 7, 14, then 30 days, counting its16passes. Spaced reps are what make a block stick, more than many in one day.17 18If the harness crashes rather than failing a check (an out-of-bounds index,19say), the runner runs it again with --trace to show the operation that was20running.21 22Your kata.rin files are yours: git ignores them, and `start` will not23overwrite one you have changed unless you add --force. A kata is a whole24program: it imports what it uses and the harness, which has main, so the25runner builds kata.rin, and the harness comes with it. rin and the C compiler26are found as tools/check.py finds them.27"""28 29from __future__ import annotations30 31import datetime as dt32import json33import os34import re35import shutil36import subprocess37import sys38from pathlib import Path39 40sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent))41from check import find_rin, list_from_build_rin  # noqa: E40242 43ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent44DOJO = ROOT / "dojo"45OUT = ROOT / "build" / "dojo"46LOG = DOJO / "log.md"47STARTED = DOJO / ".started.json"48INTERVALS = [1, 3, 7, 14, 30]49 50 51def blocks() -> list[Path]:52    return sorted((p for p in DOJO.iterdir() if p.is_dir() and re.match(r"\d+\.", p.name)),53                  key=lambda p: int(p.name.split(".")[0]))54 55 56def name_of(block: Path) -> str:57    return block.name.split(".", 1)[1]58 59 60def find(word: str) -> Path:61    found = [b for b in blocks() if word in (b.name, name_of(b), b.name.split(".")[0])]62    found = found or [b for b in blocks() if name_of(b).startswith(word)]63    if len(found) != 1:64        sys.exit(f"dojo: no single block called {word!r}; the blocks are "65                 + ", ".join(name_of(b) for b in blocks()))66    return found[0]67 68 69# The target times, from the level table in each block's README:70# | 2 | every proc | 8:00 |71def targets(block: Path) -> dict[int, str]:72    readme = block / "README.md"73    text = readme.read_text(encoding="utf-8") if readme.exists() else ""74    return {int(m.group(1)): m.group(2) for m in re.finditer(r"^\| (\d) \|.*\| (\d+:\d\d) \|$", text, re.M)}75 76 77# rin writes C, and the C compiler does the rest, as tools/check.py does. A78# kata in progress is full of unused parameters and locals, so the warnings for79# those are off and warnings are not errors; tools/check.py builds the80# solutions with -Werror and every warning on.81def build(source: Path, exe: Path, sanitize: bool) -> None:82    exe.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)83    rin = find_rin()84    c_path = exe.with_suffix(".c")85    translate = subprocess.run([str(rin), "compile", str(source), "-o", str(c_path),86                                "--header", str(exe.with_suffix(".h"))], text=True,87                               stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)88    noise = [l for l in translate.stdout.splitlines() if l.strip() and not l.startswith("rin: generated")]89    if translate.returncode != 0 or noise:90        print(translate.stdout, end="")91        sys.exit(1)92    cc = os.environ.get("CC", "clang")93    flags = ["-std=c11", "-g", "-Wall", "-Wextra", "-Wno-unused-parameter", "-Wno-unused-variable",94             "-Wno-unused-but-set-variable", "-Wno-unused-function"]95    flags += [f"-D{define}" for define in list_from_build_rin("build_defines") or []]96    if sanitize:97        flags += ["-fsanitize=address,undefined", "-fno-sanitize-recover=all"]98    includes = ["-I", str(rin.parent), "-I", str(rin.parent / "std")]99    libs = [] if os.name == "nt" else ["-lm"]100    if subprocess.run([cc, *flags, *includes, str(c_path), "-o", str(exe), *libs]).returncode != 0:101        sys.exit(1)102 103 104def load_started() -> dict:105    try:106        return json.loads(STARTED.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))107    except (OSError, ValueError):108        return {}109 110 111def save_started(started: dict) -> None:112    STARTED.write_text(json.dumps(started, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")113 114 115def log_rows() -> list[list[str]]:116    if not LOG.exists():117        return []118    rows = []119    for line in LOG.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines():120        cells = [c.strip() for c in line.strip().strip("|").split("|")]121        if len(cells) == 4 and re.match(r"\d{4}-\d\d-\d\d", cells[0]):122            rows.append(cells)123    return rows124 125 126def minutes(seconds: float) -> str:127    s = int(round(seconds))128    return f"{s // 60}:{s % 60:02d}"129 130 131def seconds(text: str) -> int:132    m, s = text.split(":")133    return int(m) * 60 + int(s)134 135 136def due(passes: list[dt.date]) -> dt.date | None:137    if not passes:138        return None139    return max(passes) + dt.timedelta(days=INTERVALS[min(len(passes), len(INTERVALS)) - 1])140 141 142def status() -> int:143    rows = log_rows()144    today = dt.date.today()145    started = load_started()146    print(f"{'block':<16}{'reps':>5}  {'best time, level':<18}{'last':<12}next")147    for b in blocks():148        mine = [r for r in rows if r[1] == name_of(b)]149        passes = [dt.date.fromisoformat(r[0]) for r in mine]150        best = min(mine, key=lambda r: (-int(r[2]), seconds(r[3])), default=None)151        best_text = f"{best[3]}, level {best[2]}" if best else "-"152        next_day = due(passes)153        next_text = "now" if next_day is None or next_day <= today else next_day.isoformat()154        if name_of(b) in started:155            next_text = f"started, level {started[name_of(b)]['level']}"156        last = max(passes).isoformat() if passes else "-"157        print(f"{b.name:<16}{len(mine):>5}  {best_text:<18}{last:<12}{next_text}")158    print()159    print("start one with: python tools/dojo.py start <block> <level 1 to 3>")160    return 0161 162 163def start(word: str, level: str, force: bool) -> int:164    b = find(word)165    source = b / f"level{level}.rin"166    if not source.exists():167        sys.exit(f"dojo: {name_of(b)} has no level {level}; the levels are "168                 + ", ".join(p.stem[len("level"):] for p in sorted(b.glob("level*.rin"))))169    kata = b / "kata.rin"170    untouched = [p.read_text(encoding="utf-8") for p in b.glob("level*.rin")]171    if kata.exists() and kata.read_text(encoding="utf-8") not in untouched and not force:172        sys.exit(f"dojo: {kata.relative_to(ROOT)} has your work in it; add --force to replace it")173    shutil.copyfile(source, kata)174    started = load_started()175    started[name_of(b)] = {"level": int(level), "at": dt.datetime.now().isoformat(timespec="seconds")}176    save_started(started)177    target = targets(b).get(int(level))178    print(f"{kata.relative_to(ROOT)} is level {level}" + (f"; the target is {target}" if target else ""))179    print(f"the clock is running. Test it with: python tools/dojo.py {name_of(b)}")180    return 0181 182 183# Run a program, printing what it prints as it prints it, and keep the text to184# look for PASS in.185def stream(cmd: list[str]) -> tuple[int, str]:186    lines = []187    with subprocess.Popen(cmd, cwd=ROOT, text=True, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT) as p:188        for line in p.stdout:189            print(line, end="", flush=True)190            lines.append(line)191    return p.returncode, "".join(lines)192 193 194def check(word: str, args: list[str]) -> int:195    b = find(word)196    if not (b / "kata.rin").exists():197        sys.exit(f"dojo: no kata.rin in {b.relative_to(ROOT)} yet; start one with: "198                 f"python tools/dojo.py start {name_of(b)} 1")199    passthrough = [a for a in args if a != "--sanitize"]200    exe = OUT / name_of(b) / ("harness.exe" if os.name == "nt" else "harness")201    build(b / "kata.rin", exe, "--sanitize" in args)202    code, out = stream([str(exe), *passthrough])203    if code != 0 and not any(line.startswith("FAIL") for line in out.splitlines()):204        traced = subprocess.run([str(exe), *passthrough, "--trace", "1"], cwd=ROOT, text=True,205                                stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)206        ops = [l for l in traced.stdout.splitlines() if l.startswith("operation ")]207        print("the harness crashed" + (f"; the last operation it started was\n    {ops[-1]}" if ops208                                       else " in the scenario, after the last step printed above"))209    if code != 0 or "PASS" not in out.splitlines():210        return 1211    started = load_started()212    entry = started.pop(name_of(b), None)213    if entry and not passthrough:214        took = (dt.datetime.now() - dt.datetime.fromisoformat(entry["at"])).total_seconds()215        if not LOG.exists():216            LOG.write_text("# Dojo log\n\n| date | block | level | time |\n|---|---|---|---|\n", encoding="utf-8")217        with LOG.open("a", encoding="utf-8") as f:218            f.write(f"| {dt.date.today().isoformat()} | {name_of(b)} | {entry['level']} | {minutes(took)} |\n")219        save_started(started)220        target = targets(b).get(entry["level"])221        print(f"\nlevel {entry['level']} in {minutes(took)}" + (f", target {target}" if target else ""))222        passes = [dt.date.fromisoformat(r[0]) for r in log_rows() if r[1] == name_of(b)]223        print(f"logged in {LOG.relative_to(ROOT)}; {name_of(b)} is due again on {due(passes).isoformat()}")224    return 0225 226 227def play(word: str) -> int:228    b = find(word)229    exe = OUT / name_of(b) / ("playground.exe" if os.name == "nt" else "playground")230    build(b / f"play_{name_of(b)}.rin", exe, False)231    return subprocess.run([str(exe)], cwd=ROOT).returncode232 233 234def main() -> int:235    args = sys.argv[1:]236    if not args:237        return status()238    if args[0] in ("-h", "--help", "help"):239        print(__doc__)240        return 0241    if args[0] == "start":242        rest = [a for a in args[1:] if a != "--force"]243        if len(rest) != 2:244            sys.exit("dojo: start <block> <level>")245        return start(rest[0], rest[1], "--force" in args)246    if args[0] == "play":247        if len(args) != 2:248            sys.exit("dojo: play <block>")249        return play(args[1])250    return check(args[0], args[1:])251 252 253if __name__ == "__main__":254    sys.exit(main())

dojo/dojo.rin

1// What every harness in the dojo shares: the run's settings, a random number2// generator that gives the same numbers everywhere, how a step is checked, and3// how a failure is reported. It also holds the two types the katas take as4// given: a handle, and a status.5//6// Every kata and harness here checks with rin's safety rules on. The handful of7// procs marked unsafe { } below read the command line and compare C strings, which8// is C's business and not the checker's.9//10// The harnesses import it, and so does every kata file that uses a handle or11// a status:12//13//   import "../dojo.rin"14 15import "std/print.rin"16import "std/memops.rin"17import "std/vec.rin"18import "std/fmt.rin"19 20// The one region every kata lives in: the harness opens it in main and hands21// it to the scenario and the fuzz run, which make their kata in it.22//23// `frame` is one step shorter: a region a harness opens and closes many times24// over a run, once per game frame or fuzz step. Blocks 5 and 11 use it. It is declared here, not in the25// harness that uses it, because a nested region must be declared right after26// its enclosing one, and an imported file's declarations come after the27// importer's own.28level: region;29frame: region in level;30 31// A generational handle: an index, and which life of that index it was made32// for. Generations start at 1, so a zeroed handle, `{}`, is never alive and can33// mean "no handle".34dojo_handle: struct = {35    index: u32;36    generation: u32;37}38 39// What a change reports. `dead` means the handle no longer names anything40// alive, so nothing changed.41dojo_status: enum[must_use] = {42    ok,43    dead,44}45 46dojo_handle_eq: proc(a: dojo_handle, b: dojo_handle) -> b32 = {47    return a.index == b.index && a.generation == b.generation;48}49 50// Writes `index:generation`.51dojo_fmt_handle: proc(f: *fmt, h: dojo_handle) -> void = {52    fmt_u64(f, cast(h.index, u64));53    fmt_char(f, ':');54    fmt_u64(f, cast(h.generation, u64));55}56 57dojo_status_name: proc(s: dojo_status) -> ^const char = {58    return s == dojo_status.ok ? "ok" : "dead";59}60 61dojo_bool_name: proc(b: b32) -> ^const char = {62    return b ? "true" : "false";63}64 65// One harness run: which block, the fuzz seed, how many operations, where to66// stop for the debugger, and whether to print each operation. The command line67// sets them:68//69//   harness --seed 42 --ops 5000 --stop 1337 --trace 170dojo_run: struct = {71    block: ^const char;72    seed: u64;73    ops: u64;74    stop: u64;75    trace: u64;76}77 78// Trusted: it walks a C string to its terminator.79dojo_parse_u64: proc(text: ^const c8, out: *u64) -> b32 = {80    unsafe {81        value: u64 = 0;82        i: u64 = 0;83        while (text[i] >= '0' && text[i] <= '9') {84            value = value * 10 + cast(text[i] - '0', u64);85            i += 1;86        }87        out* = value;88        return i > 0 && text[i] == 0;89    }90}91 92// Trusted: argv is C's array of C strings. The run lives in the region the93// harness opened, since it holds the block's name, a C string, and a struct94// with one of those is kept through a pointer in safe code.95dojo_run_init: proc(r: region R, argc: i32, argv: ^^c8, block: ^const char, title: ^const char) -> *dojo_run in R = {96    unsafe {97        run: *dojo_run in R = new<dojo_run>(r);98        run*.block = block;99        run*.seed = 1;100        run*.ops = 20000;101        for (i: i32 = 1; i < argc; i += 2) {102            value: u64 = 0;103            if (i + 1 >= argc || !dojo_parse_u64(argv[i + 1], value&)) {104                printfmt("usage: harness [--seed N] [--ops N] [--stop N] [--trace 1]\n");105                exit(2);106            }107            if (strcmp(argv[i], "--seed") == 0) {108                run*.seed = value;109            } else if (strcmp(argv[i], "--ops") == 0) {110                run*.ops = value;111            } else if (strcmp(argv[i], "--stop") == 0) {112                run*.stop = value;113            } else if (strcmp(argv[i], "--trace") == 0) {114                run*.trace = value;115            } else {116                printfmt("usage: harness [--seed N] [--ops N] [--stop N] [--trace 1]\n");117                exit(2);118            }119        }120        printfmt("dojo: {}\n", title);121        return run;122    }123}124 125// Are two C strings the same text? Safe code cannot call strcmp, which is126// C's; this is the one place that does, for the katas that keep names.127dojo_cstr_equal: proc(a: ^const char, b: ^const char) -> b32 = {128    unsafe {129        return strcmp(a, b) == 0;130    }131}132 133// A step of the scenario: what was done, what came back, and what should have.134// Printed when it matches; the end of the run when it does not. Trusted: it135// compares two C strings.136dojo_same: proc(what: ^const char, got: ^const char, want: ^const char) -> void = {137    unsafe {138        if (strcmp(got, want) != 0) {139            printfmt("FAIL in the scenario: {} gave {}, it should give {}\n", what, got, want);140            exit(1);141        }142        printfmt("    {}: {}\n", what, got);143    }144}145 146dojo_fuzz: proc(run: *dojo_run) -> void = {147    printfmt("fuzz: {} operations from seed {}, checked after each\n", run*.ops, run*.seed);148}149 150// Set a breakpoint here, and run with --stop N.151dojo_stopped_at: u64 = 0;152 153dojo_stop_here: proc(opcode: u64) -> void = {154    dojo_stopped_at = opcode;155}156 157// Call before operation `op`. It returns 1 when the operation should be158// described, and the caller prints the description and a newline: with159// --trace, every operation is, so a crash shows the last one that started;160// with --stop at this operation, it is, after dojo_stop_here has run, so a161// breakpoint there lands just before it.162dojo_before: proc(run: *dojo_run, opcode: u64) -> b32 = {163    if (run*.stop == opcode) {164        dojo_stop_here(opcode);165        printfmt("stopped before operation {}: ", opcode);166        return 1;167    }168    if (run*.trace != 0) {169        printfmt("operation {}: ", opcode);170        return 1;171    }172    return 0;173}174 175// A failure in the fuzz run, in three parts: dojo_fail starts the line, the176// caller prints what went wrong and a newline, and dojo_failed says how to get177// back here in the debugger and ends the run.178dojo_fail: proc(run: *dojo_run, opcode: u64) -> void = {179    printfmt("FAIL at operation {} (seed {}): ", opcode, run*.seed);180}181 182dojo_failed: proc(run: *dojo_run, opcode: u64) -> void = {183    printfmt("    debug it: build/dojo/{}/harness --seed {} --stop {}\n", run*.block, run*.seed, opcode);184    printfmt("    with a breakpoint on dojo_stop_here, which runs just before that operation\n");185    exit(1);186}187 188dojo_pass: proc() -> void = {189    printfmt("PASS\n");190}191 192// splitmix64: a few lines, fast, and the same numbers on every machine and in193// rust-dod's dojo, so a seed means the same run everywhere. u64 arithmetic194// wraps, as splitmix64 wants.195dojo_rng: struct = {196    state: u64;197}198 199dojo_rng_next: proc(r: *dojo_rng) -> u64 = {200    r*.state = r*.state + 11400714819323198485'u64;201    z: u64 = r*.state;202    z = (z ^ (z shr 30)) * 13787848793156543929'u64;203    z = (z ^ (z shr 27)) * 10723151780598845931'u64;204    return z ^ (z shr 31);205}206 207// A number in 0..n.208dojo_rng_below: proc(r: *dojo_rng, n: u64) -> u64 = {209    return dojo_rng_next(r) % n;210}

1// How the lessons are built. Read by `rin build`, not executed.2//3// Every lesson is its own program, named after its file. tools/check.py reads4// this same list, builds each lesson, runs it and compares its output with the5// .expected file beside it.6build_name:      ^const char = "rin-dod";7build_dir:       ^const char = "build";8build_generator: ^const char = "Ninja";9build_compiler:  ^const char = "clang-cl";10build_type:      ^const char = "Debug";11 12// std's string8 calls fopen, which the Windows SDK marks deprecated.13build_defines: [_]^const char = { "_CRT_SECURE_NO_WARNINGS" };14 15build_entries: [_]^const char = {16    // Build an ECS: start here, README.md17    "ecs/src/1.entities/1.1.ids/ids.rin",18    "ecs/src/1.entities/1.2.despawn/despawn.rin",19 "ecs/src/3.systems/3.1.queries/queries.rin",29    "ecs/src/3.systems/3.2.systems/systems.rin",30    "ecs/src/3.systems/3.3.commands/commands.rin",31    "ecs/src/3.systems/3.4.game/game.rin",32 33    // Advanced: layout and SIMD, docs/README.md34    "src/1.aos_vs_soa/aos_vs_soa.rin",35    "src/2.archetype_table/archetype_table.rin",36    "src/3.many_archetypes/many_archetypes.rin",37    "src/4.entity_handles/entity_handles.rin",38    "src/5.inspector/inspector.rin",39    "src/6.kayan/kayan.rin",40    "src/7.access_patterns/access_patterns.rin",41 42    // The dojo's playgrounds, dojo/README.md43    "dojo/1.free_list/play_free_list.rin",44    "dojo/2.swap_remove/play_swap_remove.rin",45    "dojo/3.slot_map/play_slot_map.rin",46    "dojo/4.column/play_column.rin",47    "dojo/5.commands/play_commands.rin",48    "dojo/6.bitset/play_bitset.rin",49    "dojo/7.arena/play_arena.rin",50    "dojo/8.index/play_index.rin",51    "dojo/9.interning/play_interning.rin",52    "dojo/10.edges/play_edges.rin",53    "dojo/11.reflect/play_reflect.rin",54    "dojo/12.watermark/play_watermark.rin",55    "dojo/13.dispatch/play_dispatch.rin",56};
